data.title: Sync Go client with Python notebooklm-py API changes
data.body:
## Scope
Bring the Go nlm client in line with recent Google API changes tracked by the Python notebooklm-py reference implementation.

## Non-goals
- Adding entirely new feature commands (research, export, etc.) — only fix divergent values and stale params for existing functionality
- Rewriting the grpcendpoint package (dead code, separate cleanup)

## Key decisions
- Python notebooklm-py (teng-lin/notebooklm-py) is the source of truth for API values
- Submodule at reference/notebooklm-py for cross-referencing

data.title: Update stale BL (Build Label) param
data.body:
## Goal
- Update the default BL param from `20260210.19` to `20260301.03` across all Go files
- Also update the ancient `20250903.07` in grpcendpoint/handler.go and the `20250129.00` in proto template

## Context
- Python default: `boq_labs-tailwind-frontend_20260301.03_p0`
- Go rpc/rpc.go: `20260210.19` (3 weeks behind)
- Go grpcendpoint/handler.go: `20250903.07` (6 months behind)
- Go proto template: `20250129.00`
- Gen service files: `20260210.19`
- All support NLM_BL_PARAM env override, but defaults should match Python

## Acceptance Criteria
- All hardcoded BL params updated to `20260301.03`
- `grep -r boq_labs-tailwind *.go **/*.go` shows only `20260301.03` (excluding testdata/reference)

## Validation Gates
- `go build ./...`
- `grep -rn boq_labs-tailwind --include="*.go" | grep -v testdata | grep -v reference | grep -v 20260301`  should return nothing

data.title: Fix ChatGoal and ResponseLength enum values
data.body:
## Goal
- Align ChatGoal and ResponseLength constants with Python reference values
- Current Go values appear swapped/wrong vs Python

## Context
- ChatGoal: Go has Default=3, LearningGuide=1, Custom=2. Python has DEFAULT=1, CUSTOM=2, LEARNING_GUIDE=3
- ResponseLength: Go has Default=0, Longer=4, Shorter=3. Python has DEFAULT=1, LONGER=4, SHORTER=5

## Acceptance Criteria
- ChatGoalDefault=1, ChatGoalCustom=2, ChatGoalLearningGuide=3
- ResponseLengthDefault=1, ResponseLengthLonger=4, ResponseLengthShorter=5
- SetChatConfig logic updated if needed (e.g. default check changes from 0 to 1)
- chat-config CLI subcommand still works with updated values

## Validation Gates
- `go build ./...`
- `go vet ./...`

data.title: Reconcile divergent RPC method IDs
data.body:
## Goal
- Fix RPC method IDs that differ between Go and Python
- Resolve the e3bVqc conflict (Go=DeleteChatHistory vs Python=PollResearch)

## Context
- CreateArtifact: Go=`xpWGLf` vs Python=`R7cb6c`
- DeleteArtifact: Go=`WxBZtb` vs Python=`V5N4be`
- e3bVqc: Go maps to DeleteChatHistory, Python maps to PollResearch — one is wrong or Google repurposed the ID
- Python unified all artifact creation under R7cb6c with ArtifactTypeCode discriminator
- File: internal/notebooklm/rpc/rpc.go
- Python source: reference/notebooklm-py/src/notebooklm/rpc/types.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- CreateArtifact and DeleteArtifact IDs match Python
- e3bVqc usage clarified — if Go DeleteChatHistory is wrong, find correct ID or remove
- Any callers of changed IDs updated
- Existing commands (create-artifact, delete-artifact, delete-chat) still build

## Validation Gates
- `go build ./...`
- `go vet ./...`

data.title: Add artifact quota failure detection
data.body:
## Goal
- Detect when artifact creation silently fails due to daily quota
- Match Python behavior: after N consecutive not_found polls, report quota error instead of timing out

## Context
- Python added this April 2 (commit 0431411)
- When Google rejects artifact creation due to quota, the artifact vanishes from list responses
- Python detects 3 consecutive not_found polls and surfaces a quota error
- Without this, Go artifact creation hangs until timeout with no useful error
- Relevant Python file: reference/notebooklm-py/src/notebooklm/_artifacts.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- Artifact polling loop tracks consecutive not_found responses
- After 3 consecutive not_found, returns descriptive quota error
- Normal artifact flow (processing → completed) unaffected
- Normal not_found (single transient miss) does not trigger false positive

## Validation Gates
- `go build ./...`
- `go vet ./...`

## Goal
- Update the default BL param from 20260210.19 to 20260301.03 across all Go files

## Completion
Updated 6 files: rpc.go, grpcendpoint/handler.go (2 occurrences), 3 gen/service files, proto template. All now match Python default 20260301.03_p0.

## Goal
- Align ChatGoal and ResponseLength with Python reference

## Completion
ChatGoal: Default=1, Custom=2, LearningGuide=3. ResponseLength: Default=1, Longer=4, Shorter=5. SetChatConfig now uses 0 as no-change sentinel for both goal and length (not a valid enum value). CLI passes 0 when only changing one setting.

## Goal
- Fix divergent RPC method IDs

## Completion
CreateArtifact: xpWGLf → R7cb6c (matches Python unified artifact endpoint). DeleteArtifact: WxBZtb → V5N4be. Added comment on RPCCreateVideoOverview noting it shares the R7cb6c ID. Added comment on e3bVqc noting Python maps it to PollResearch — kept as DeleteChatHistory for now since no research features in Go yet.

data.summary: Artifact/source enum types matching Python notebooklm-py reference

data.body:
## Goal
- Add missing RPC method IDs and artifact enums from Python

## Completion
Added 7 RPC IDs to rpc.go: ExportArtifact, GetInteractiveHTML, ReviseSlide, StartFastResearch, StartDeepResearch, PollResearch, ImportResearch. Created artifact_types.go with 16 enum types matching Python exactly: ArtifactTypeCode, ArtifactStatus, AudioFormat, AudioLength, VideoFormat, VideoStyle, QuizQuantity, QuizDifficulty, InfographicOrientation/Detail/Style, SlideDeckFormat/Length, ExportType, SourceStatus, ShareViewLevel.

data.summary: WaitForArtifact with quota-failure detection matching Python behavior

data.body:
## Goal
- Detect artifact quota failures instead of timing out

## Completion
Created artifact_poll.go with WaitForArtifact(ctx, projectID, artifactID) — polls ListArtifacts with exponential backoff (2s→10s), tracks consecutive and total not_found responses. After 5 consecutive not_found spanning >=10s (or 10 total), returns descriptive quota error. Matches Python wait_for_completion semantics. 5min timeout with context cancellation support.

data.title: NotebookLM Python v0.4.1 API parity
data.body:
## Scope
- Bring this Go client into parity with the API/protocol-relevant changes identified from the vendored `reference/notebooklm-py` update to `v0.4.1` (`59d95cd`, released 2026-05-11).
- Prioritize Google API behavior changes: auth/cookie rotation, cookie scoping, parser field drift, source type/upload drift, artifact URL/status extraction, and generation option drift.

## Non-goals
- Do not blindly port Python-only packaging, issue templates, or docs churn.
- Do not add Python's full profile-management UX unless required to support the auth/API behavior in this Go CLI.

## Key Evidence
- `reference/notebooklm-py/CHANGELOG.md` v0.4.0 and v0.4.1.
- `reference/notebooklm-py/src/notebooklm/rpc/types.py`.
- Existing Go surfaces in `internal/notebooklm/rpc/rpc.go`, `internal/notebooklm/api/client.go`, `internal/notebooklm/api/artifact_types.go`, `internal/auth`, `cmd/nlm`, and `proto/notebooklm/v1alpha1`.

## Assumptions
- The reference should remain pinned to the latest release tag, not upstream `main`.
- This plan tracks implementation work; the submodule pointer bump itself is a separate local change already present.

Unresolved questions: none

data.title: Audit and align v0.4.1 RPC/proto constants
data.body:
## Goal
- Reconcile the Go RPC constants, proto method options, generated clients, and docs against the v0.4.1 Python source of truth.
- Remove or clearly quarantine stale/conflicting IDs so future agents do not call the wrong endpoint.

## Context
- Compare against `reference/notebooklm-py/src/notebooklm/rpc/types.py` and `reference/notebooklm-py/docs/rpc-reference.md`.
- Current risk examples: `e3bVqc` is research polling in Python but also appears as chat deletion in Go comments; `ozz5Z` is user tier in Python but is currently labeled log event in Go.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `internal/notebooklm/rpc/rpc.go` names/comments match the v0.4.1 reference for shared IDs.
- `proto/notebooklm/v1alpha1/*.proto` RPC options are updated where the Python reference has a newer confirmed mapping.
- Generated files are refreshed only if proto changes require it.
- Add or update a persistent test or generator check that catches at least one representative stale-ID regression.

## Validation Gates
- `go test ./internal/notebooklm/rpc ./gen/service ./cmd/nlm`
- `go test ./...`

data.title: Implement RotateCookies auth keepalive parity
data.body:
## Goal
- Adapt the v0.4.1 auth stability changes to the Go auth model.
- Prevent stale Google session cookies during long-running CLI/MCP/API use.

## Context
- Python v0.4.1 added an `accounts.google.com/RotateCookies` poke before token fetch, a 60s mtime/recency guard, in-process and cross-process dedupe, and `NOTEBOOKLM_DISABLE_KEEPALIVE_POKE=1`.
- Existing Go auth currently has `internal/auth/refresh.go` using the signaler refresh path and `cmd/nlm refresh`, but not the RotateCookies flow.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add a Go auth helper for the RotateCookies POST with timeout, debug logging, and a disable env var.
- Rate-limit sequential calls and dedupe concurrent calls so fan-out does not stampede the endpoint.
- Integrate it into the normal auth/token loading path used by CLI and API clients without breaking unauthenticated validation paths.
- Persistent tests cover success, disabled mode, timeout/non-2xx tolerance, and concurrent dedupe.

## Validation Gates
- `go test ./internal/auth ./cmd/nlm`
- `go test ./...`

data.title: Harden cookie persistence and upload cookie scoping
data.body:
## Goal
- Preserve enough cookie metadata to scope requests correctly across NotebookLM, Google identity, and upload hosts.
- Prevent file upload failures caused by sending unrelated cookies to upload endpoints.

## Context
- Python v0.4.1 fixed domain/path/secure attribute preservation, flat-cookie selection consistency, and per-domain cookie scoping for file uploads.
- Go currently tends to carry cookies as a flat header string, especially through `internal/auth` and `internal/notebooklm/api/client.go`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Introduce or reuse a structured cookie representation at the boundary where domain/path scoping matters.
- File upload code sends only cookies applicable to the upload host.
- Loading/saving credentials does not silently drop domain/path/security attributes when those attributes are available.
- Legacy `NLM_COOKIES` flat-cookie input continues to work with a documented fallback path.
- Persistent tests cover mixed-domain jars, upload host selection, and flat-cookie compatibility.

## Validation Gates
- `go test ./internal/auth ./internal/notebooklm/api`
- `go test ./...`

data.title: Surface new notebook/source/artifact response fields safely
data.body:
## Goal
- Align Go response parsing with v0.4.1 field drift: notebook source counts, source created timestamps, artifact URLs, generation status URLs, and malformed timestamp tolerance.

## Context
- Python v0.4.1 populated `Notebook.sources_count`, `Source.created_at`, `Artifact.url`, and `GenerationStatus.url`, and hardened timestamp parsing against non-numeric/out-of-range values.
- Go currently uses protobuf-shaped structs plus direct response parsing in `internal/notebooklm/api/client.go`; verify which fields are missing or silently discarded.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Public Go structs or accessors expose the new values where the CLI/API already has equivalent concepts.
- Parsing handles nested and deeply nested response paths covered by the Python reference.
- Bad timestamp values resolve to zero/nil-style values instead of panics or hard failures.
- CLI JSON output includes the fields where existing JSON output already exposes analogous metadata.
- Persistent tests cover normal values, missing values, and malformed timestamp values.

## Validation Gates
- `go test ./internal/notebooklm/api ./cmd/nlm`
- `go test ./...`

data.title: Add EPUB/source-type parity and upload coverage
data.body:
## Goal
- Bring source type handling and upload registration in line with the v0.4.1 reference, including EPUB.

## Context
- Python v0.4.0 added source type code 17 for EPUB and documents current raw source type codes in `docs/rpc-reference.md`.
- Go proto/source enums currently collapse many uploaded file types into `SOURCE_TYPE_LOCAL_FILE`; the CLI upload path needs an audit for `.epub` MIME detection and display behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `.epub` files are accepted and registered with the correct MIME/source type behavior for NotebookLM.
- Source type constants/proto/docs either represent EPUB explicitly or document the deliberate mapping if the Go API keeps a collapsed enum.
- Existing PDF, DOCX, CSV, Markdown, image, media, YouTube, web, and pasted text behavior does not regress.
- Persistent tests cover EPUB detection/registration payload and at least two existing upload types as regression checks.

## Validation Gates
- `go test ./internal/notebooklm/api ./cmd/nlm`
- `go test ./...`

data.title: Align artifact URL extraction and generation options
data.body:
## Goal
- Match v0.4.1 artifact readiness and generation option behavior for media artifacts and mind maps.

## Context
- Python v0.4.x consolidated artifact URL extraction, fixed completed video URL detection, added `GenerationStatus.url`, supports expanded video/infographic style constants, and lets mind-map generation accept language/instructions.
- Go has style constants in `internal/notebooklm/api/artifact_types.go`, direct artifact parsing in `client.go`, and `cmd/nlm generate-mindmap` currently routes through source actions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Audio, video, infographic, slide deck, report, quiz, flashcard, mind-map, and data-table artifact handling uses a shared URL/status extraction contract where applicable.
- Video URL selection prefers quality-4 MP4, then any MP4, then the first valid URL, matching the Python reference.
- Mind-map generation supports language and instructions if the underlying API path supports it in Go.
- CLI flags and docs are updated only for options actually implemented.
- Persistent tests cover media URL selection, completed-video detection, and mind-map option payloads.

## Validation Gates
- `go test ./internal/notebooklm/api ./cmd/nlm`
- `go test ./...`

data.summary: RPC parity regression coverage for v0.4.1 constants and generated report suggestions

data.body:
## Goal
- Reconcile the Go RPC constants, proto method options, generated clients, and docs against the v0.4.1 Python source of truth.
- Remove or clearly quarantine stale/conflicting IDs so future agents do not call the wrong endpoint.

## Context
- Compared against `reference/notebooklm-py/src/notebooklm/rpc/types.py` and `reference/notebooklm-py/docs/rpc-reference.md`.
- Fixed the confirmed drift where report suggestions moved to `ciyUvf` with `[[2], notebook_id]` arguments, `e3bVqc` is research polling rather than chat deletion, and `ozz5Z` is user tier rather than generic log-event telemetry.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `internal/notebooklm/rpc/rpc.go` names/comments match the v0.4.1 reference for shared IDs.
- `proto/notebooklm/v1alpha1/*.proto` RPC options are updated where the Python reference has a newer confirmed mapping.
- Generated report-suggestions call sites were patched manually because `make generate` is blocked by missing `protoc-gen-anything` on this machine.
- Added `internal/notebooklm/rpc/rpc_contract_test.go` to catch representative stale-ID regressions in constants and generated report-suggestions output.

## Completion
- Updated report suggestions from `GHsKob` to `ciyUvf` and changed the argument shape to `[[2], %project_id%]` in proto and generated call sites.
- Replaced stale chat-history aliases with current conversation names and disabled `DeleteChatHistory` instead of calling the research polling endpoint.
- Renamed the `ozz5Z` constant to `RPCGetUserTier`.

## Validation Gates

data.summary: EPUB MIME and file-registration payload regression coverage

data.body:
## Goal
- Bring source type handling and upload registration in line with the v0.4.1 reference, including EPUB.

## Context
- Python v0.4.0 added source type code 17 for EPUB and documents current raw source type codes in `docs/rpc-reference.md`.
- Go proto/source enums currently collapse many uploaded file types into `SOURCE_TYPE_LOCAL_FILE`; this task documents that deliberate mapping while making EPUB upload behavior explicit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `.epub` files are accepted and detected as `application/epub+zip` for NotebookLM uploads.
- `proto/notebooklm/v1alpha1/notebooklm.proto` documents that the Go hand-written proto keeps a collapsed `SOURCE_TYPE_LOCAL_FILE` enum even though NotebookLM raw responses distinguish EPUB as code 17.
- Existing PDF and DOCX upload MIME behavior is covered as regression coverage.
- Persistent tests cover EPUB/PDF/DOCX MIME detection and file-upload registration payload shape.

## Completion
- Added explicit NotebookLM upload MIME mapping for `.epub`, `.pdf`, `.docx`, and `.csv` before generic content sniffing can classify EPUB/DOCX as zip data.
- Factored file-source registration arguments into `buildRegisterFileSourceArgs` so the payload is persistently testable.
- Added tests for EPUB MIME detection and EPUB/PDF/DOCX registration payloads.

## Validation Gates
- `go test ./internal/notebooklm/api ./cmd/nlm`
- `go test ./...`
